svg.aria-label: A terminal running pr-board list on the fictional demo organization: the header '⑂ acme 46 mine · 4 to review', then one row per PR with two lights, CI then review, the repository, the number in its state's colour and the title, worst first, ending in '+ 42 more'. Along the bottom, the statusline segment '[PRs] ✓12 ✗16 ◷15 ⊙4 ✎3': ready to merge, something missing, ready to approve, to review and drafts.
